android.notes:
InForm 1.3.0 brings on-device motion tracking to Android.

- Select an area in a video and track it forward with the bundled EdgeTAM model. Multi-point and angle tracks can follow separate targets together.
- Tracking controls, target editing, and the guide have been refined. The guide now fits at larger text sizes.
- Project import and backup handling is more resilient to same-name media and damaged archives.

Install this signed APK over an existing InForm beta to keep your videos, drawings, and projects. Do not uninstall to update: uninstalling deletes app data. Back up important projects from the hub menu.
